name: Tuck Jump
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly bent.
Dip into a quick quarter squat.
Jump straight up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Release the legs and land softly with bent knees.
Reset your balance before the next jump.

common_mistakes.fix: Bend knees and hips to absorb the landing

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding forward to reach the knees
common_mistakes.fix: Bring knees up to you, chest stays tall
Stop when landings become loud or sloppy
